recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast male portrait with a warm-to-cool color shift, featuring bold, vertically-compressed typography and organic, horizontal brushstroke overlays.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed at the viewer creates immediate engagement.
Typography is anchored to the lower right, balancing the subject's head on the left.
Horizontal green paint strokes intersect the subject and text to unify the composition.
coreInvariants: Cinematic rim lighting on the hair and face.
A dominant green and yellow color cast in the highlights.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait positioned slightly off-center to the left, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, emphasized by sharp focus and bright catchlights.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the face to the large white text, then follows the green strokes to the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, out-of-focus background on the right provides a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark greens in the shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lime and forest green for the graphic brushstrokes and facial highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and dark background; saturation is concentrated in the green overlays.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm yellow-green bias in skin tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' has a simple bar without a spur
The 'R' has a straight diagonal leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same font family or similar condensed styles.
graphicDevices: Horizontal, semi-transparent green brushstrokes with rounded ends

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the primary text.
Offers various condensed weights suitable for the hierarchy.
A clean, modern condensed sans-serif that fits the aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with curly hair and light eyes. Use cinematic lighting with a yellow-green tint on the highlights and deep shadows. The background should be a dark, out-of-focus interior. Apply horizontal, textured green paint strokes across the bottom third of the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in large, white, ultra-condensed bold sans-serif text, right-aligned in the lower right. Below it, add the title in a smaller, light green condensed sans-serif font, also right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting on the face consistent with the green/yellow color palette?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the green color cast
Thickness and placement of the horizontal brushstrokes
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is legible against the background.
Check that the green strokes do not obscure the subject's mouth or eyes.
Verify the color grading feels cinematic rather than muddy.
Confirm the typography feels vertically stretched and modern.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Cinematic Green Tint + Ultra-Condensed Right-Aligned Typography + Horizontal Paint Overlays
